definitions.explanation: A person one works with at the same company or organization.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}と{昼|ひる}ごはんを{食|た}べました。
examples.english: I had lunch with my colleague.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}はみんな{親切|しんせつ}です。
{新|あたら}しい{同僚|どうりょう}が{入|はい}ってきました。
{同僚|どうりょう}と{仕事|しごと}の{後|あと}で{飲|の}みに{行|い}くことがありますが、{毎週|まいしゅう}ではありません。
examples.english: I sometimes go drinking with colleagues after work, but not every week.

notes:
{同僚|どうりょう} refers to coworkers at a similar level in the same organization.

ETYMOLOGY:
{同|どう} (same) + {僚|りょう} (companion)

SCOPE:
{同僚|どうりょう} specifically means peers or equals at work. It does not include:
- {上司|じょうし}: superiors, bosses
- {部下|ぶか}: subordinates

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同僚|どうりょう}と{働|はたら}く: to work with colleagues
- {元|もと}{同僚|どうりょう}: former colleague
- {同僚|どうりょう}{関係|かんけい}: colleague relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同僚|どうりょう}: colleague (same organization, peer level)
- {仲間|なかま}: companion, member of a group
- {同期|どうき}: someone who joined at the same time
